high_level_description: The image depicts a formal interview or discussion setting. Two individuals are seated on white armchairs with gold legs, positioned across from each other at a small round wooden table. The person on the left is holding a microphone and appears to be speaking, while the person on the right is listening attentively. The background features a geometric patterned wall in white and light gray tones, adding a modern and clean aesthetic to the scene. On either side of the table, there are small wooden side tables with a blue bottle and a white cup placed on them.
